clue.text: Wine added to menu at a fancy gastropub perhaps (11)

indicators.note: something added to another thing is joined on, so the wine sits in front of the rest

blocks.note: port is a fortified wine from Portugal
anagram fodder, 7 letters

annotation.surface: A trendy pub restaurant pairs a glass of wine with its fancy menu.
annotation.walkthrough: The pub setting of the surface turns out to be the definition itself: 'gastropub' is an example of a blended word.
annotation.definitionFit: Gastropub fuses 'gastronomic' and 'pub', and a word made by fusing two others is called a portmanteau, so this is a definition by example.

clue.text: Dog and Duck opening in the afternoon (3)

annotation.definitionFit: Pom is the short name for a Pomeranian, a small fluffy breed, so a plain abbreviation for a kind of dog.

clue.text: Alcohol treatment centre male in pub recalled? (5)

clue.text: Venomous sort, privileged American leaving wife (3)

the last letter of love

clue.text: What might be Cox’s first offence? (6,5)
